bibliographic.title: A Clean Getaway
bibliographic.author: Requiem
bibliographic.description:
Howdy!

Made in 30 minutes for Neo-Twiny jam.
Under 500 words, featuring as many references I can cram within the restriction.

You are an outlaw.
How long can you survive on the run?
Tips

⦿You will never get caught on the 1st day
⦿Food is subtracted at the start of every day
⦿Laying low will remove 1-3 points of heat
⦿Going out to find food will garner 1-3 points of heat
⦿Bribing will remove 2-4 points of heat, but does not guarantee you not getting caught again the next day
⦿At 0 point of heat, you have 9% chance of being caught
⦿At 10 points of heat, you have 100% chance of being caught
Scoring

1-4 days: O Fortuna, where art thou?
5-7 days: The Prisoner of the Tower
8-12 days: Pillager of Twilight
13-18 days: Magician of the Silver Sky
19 days+: The Great Wizard of the Century
